reviews.question:
With the rapid development of communication technology; e.g. smart phones, tablets and other mobile devices, some people believe that the disadvantages outweigh the advantages.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, communication technology is developing rapidly, especially with the use of smartphones, tablets, and other mobile devices. Although some people believe that the disadvantages outweigh the advantages, I completely disagree with this opinion because I believe that the benefits are greater.
 On the one hand, it is undeniable that certain risks exist, but these issues can be easily resolved. Social network platforms, by their nature, make it relatively easy to fake identities, leaving users vulnerable to cyberattacks. This is evidenced by the increasing number of reports of online scams using hacked social media accounts or stolen personal identification numbers. However, identity theft has always been a problem, and it is not primarily due to the lack of security of a particular networking site or application, but rather due to users' carelessness. Therefore, with proper care and attention, social network users can successfully protect themselves from fraud. By adjusting privacy settings and turning on two-step verification, they can greatly reduce the risk of identity theft.
 On the other hand, this technological shift is generally a very positive development. Modern devices facilitate long-distance communication, enabling people to connect no matter where they are. Consequently, individuals from all corners of the globe can now interact instantly through messaging or video calls. This was rarely the case in the past, when people had limited chances to engage with others outside their immediate surroundings. This benefit is clearly seen in the business sector, where virtual meetings and cross-border collaboration have become the norm. Moreover, video conferencing allows participants from different time zones to join live discussions, so companies can significantly reduce travel costs and speed up decision-making. This is particularly beneficial for startups and small businesses aiming to expand internationally.
 In conclusion, although communication technology has some disadvantages, I believe that its advantages outweigh its drawbacks.
reviews.overall: Em bám rất sát toàn bộ ý, chuỗi giải thích và ví dụ Cô giao; hai đoạn thân bài phát triển rõ, đặc biệt phần phản biện rủi ro danh tính. Bài cũng đủ số từ và hầu như không có lỗi cơ bản. Em cần sửa câu nêu quan điểm ở mở bài bằng mẫu đã học thay vì chỉ viết “I completely disagree”, rồi giữ cách diễn đạt đó nhất quán trong bài.

reviews.question:
Some people think that the increasing use of computers and mobile phones for communication has a negative effect on young people’s reading and writing skills.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
It is often argued that the increasing use of computers and mobile phones for communication has a negative effect on the reading and writing skills of young people. I completely agree with this opinion because digital communication can harm both of these important skills.
 On the one hand, the increasing use of digital devices has a negative effect on young people's reading skills. What they read on these devices is often in bite-sized snippets, which directly affects their ability to stay focused for a longer period of time. Consequently, this leads to comprehension problems when it comes to longer texts. To make matters worse, notifications pushed to their phones from social media platforms constantly distract them when they try to read, which further affects their reading comprehension.
 On the other hand, technological communication also severely damages their writing skills. There is a noticeable rise in informal language used in online interactions, which is characterized by the use of slang, abbreviations, and emojis. For the sake of convenience in communicating, young people do not adhere strictly to grammar and punctuation rules. Furthermore, they heavily rely on functions such as text prediction and auto-correction on computers and smartphones, which eventually leads them to make spelling mistakes. Such colloquial language and grammar mistakes become much less acceptable in more formal contexts, such as academic essays, business proposals, and professional correspondence.
 In conclusion, I strongly believe that using phones and computers for communication has a negative effect on young people's reading and writing skills.
reviews.overall: Em bám sát toàn bộ dàn ý Cô giao: đoạn 1 giải thích ảnh hưởng lên reading skills, còn đoạn 2 triển khai đủ informal language, lỗi ngữ pháp/dấu câu và auto-correction. Chuỗi ý rõ, các ví dụ về ngữ cảnh học thuật và công việc cũng đúng nguồn. Em chỉ cần sửa câu nêu quan điểm ở mở bài bằng mẫu đã học, thay vì dừng ở câu đồng ý đơn giản.

reviews.question:
The Internet has transformed the way information is shared and consumed, but it has also created problems that did not exist before.
What are the most serious problems associated with the Internet and what are the possible solutions?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, the Internet has changed the way people share and receive information around the world. However, it has also created some serious problems. This essay will discuss the main problems caused by the Internet and suggest some possible solutions.
 Regarding the most serious problems, the proliferation of the Internet has brought in its wake severe problems, specifically in the form of cyberbullying and manipulation. Looking at the former, social media is frequently used to spread lies and rumors to thousands of people in an instant. Due to the invasive nature of this type of bullying, there is simply no way for the victim to escape it. Furthermore, there is hardly any regulation on what type of information is put on the Internet, allowing malicious people to use it to their advantage. A clear example of this can be seen in the way the Trump administration won the US presidential election, in large part and in large measure, by running targeted advertisements on social media platforms like Facebook.
 To address these issues, several solutions must be brought to the fore. First, combating cyberbullying can be done by mounting awareness campaigns about the problems associated with using the Internet, especially cyberbullying itself. Since celebrities are deeply trusted by the public, they can help spread the message on their platforms. For example, they can talk about the psychological distress a bullied person has to endure. On the other hand, manipulation is much more difficult to tackle. Governments could introduce legislation to check the content of social media posts and adverts. However, because checking content is in itself a form of manipulation, deciding what is illegal can become highly subjective and ultimately take away freedom of speech.
 In conclusion, the Internet causes some serious problems, such as cyberbullying and manipulation. However, these problems can be reduced with proper solutions.
reviews.overall: Em trả lời đủ hai phần của đề và giữ đúng toàn bộ chuỗi ý, ví dụ và giới hạn của dàn ý. Sửa hai chỗ dùng cụm từ chưa chính xác để bài rõ và tự nhiên hơn.

reviews.question:
Some people believe that reading stories from a book is better than watching TV or playing computer games for children.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
It is often argued that books can provide greater benefits for children than watching television or spending time on computer games. I agree because reading can help children develop their language skills and strengthen their imagination.
 On the one hand, reading stories can enrich their language ability and help them absorb knowledge better. In contrast, children watching TV shows or movies can also learn new words, expressions, and grammar structures, but they are less exposed to diverse and complicated language. Similarly, those who are playing video games are asked to read a text to know what to do to win or what their next mission is. Therefore, these children only use some of the texts around the context of the game and are not exposed to as many aspects of life stories as those who read books.
 On the other hand, reading fictional or real-life stories allows children to have better imagination. When reading, they have to conjure up images of a wondrous world, a homeless person’s suffering, or a joyous moment. Doing this can boost creativity. In comparison, watching a certain TV programme means that children only observe what is happening on the screen, which is the product of someone else’s imagination. Similarly, gamers use different strategies and tactics, which are the fruit of experience rather than creativity.
 In conclusion, I believe that reading stories from books is better for children than watching TV or playing computer games. This is because reading helps them develop their language skills as well as their imagination and creativity.

reviews.question:
Some people think that studying at university or college is the best way for students to prepare for their future career. Others, however, say today this is no longer true.
Discuss both views and give your opinion.
reviews.originalEssay:
It is often argued that university education is the most suitable way for students to prepare for their future careers, while others believe that this is no longer the case. I agree with the second view because university education is not suitable for every student, and vocational training can provide more practical opportunities.
 First of all, it is undeniable that university education is highly relevant to career preparation. It provides students with in-depth knowledge and qualifications in many professions. For example, it is impossible to become a doctor, a teacher, or a lawyer without having the relevant degree. In addition, university education helps learners to develop high-level skills, such as critical thinking, independent research, and structured communication, which are highly valued personal traits in many modern occupations.
 However, university education is far from being universally suitable for every student in today’s world. Many young people struggle with abstract or theoretical knowledge, while they are talented in practical tasks. Therefore, vocational training is a more realistic and rewarding alternative for these students, as it helps them gain hands-on experience and enter the workforce earlier in areas such as construction, automotive repair, or culinary arts. For instance, a student with little academic interest but a passion for cooking may find greater success in a culinary school than in a university lecture hall. Therefore, a one-size-fits-all approach to education can hinder rather than help students, leading to wasted time and missed opportunities.
 In conclusion, although university education is an effective way to prepare students for some careers, I believe that it is not the right path for everyone.

reviews.question:
Too much emphasis is placed on going to university for academic education. People should be encouraged to do vocational training, because there is a lack of qualified tradespeople such as electricians or plumbers.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
It is often argued that society places too much importance on university education and that more people should choose vocational training because there is a shortage of skilled workers. I disagree with this view because both university education and vocational training are important and should be equally encouraged.
 On the one hand, university education plays a critical role in building a highly skilled workforce, which is essential for key sectors of the national economy such as healthcare, education, engineering, and technology. For example, doctors not only improve public health but also save thousands of lives daily. Similarly, qualified engineers and technicians contribute significantly to national productivity and technological innovation. Therefore, without sufficient investment in higher education, countries will inevitably face a dearth of professional doctors, researchers, and policymakers, which will ultimately hinder long-term national progress.
 On the other hand, vocational training should be emphasized no less than academic education because not all young people are academically capable. For these individuals, vocational training serves as a more realistic and rewarding alternative. It enables them to gain hands-on experience and enter the workforce earlier in practical areas such as construction, automotive repair, or culinary arts. However, blindly encouraging all students to pursue higher education would result in wasted resources and high youth unemployment rates. Therefore, promoting vocational education as a viable and respectable path will help reduce graduate unemployment while ensuring that all individuals are matched with careers that suit their strengths.
 In conclusion, I believe that both university education and vocational training are important for society. Instead of focusing too much on one path, both should be encouraged to meet the different needs of the workforce.
reviews.overall: Em bám rất sát dàn ý: hai đoạn thân đều có câu chủ đề, cơ chế và hệ quả phù hợp; các ví dụ cũng nối đúng với ý chính. Bài đủ số từ và diễn đạt nhìn chung chính xác. Tuy nhiên, câu nêu quan điểm vẫn dừng ở “I disagree”, chưa vận dụng mẫu quan điểm Cô đã học; phần thân bài cũng còn ít cơ hội dùng câu bị động đa dạng. Em sửa hai chỗ này rồi tự soát lại trước khi nộp lại.

reviews.question:
The government should invest more money in teaching science than other subjects for a country’s development and progress.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
It is often argued that governments should spend more money on science education than on other subjects to support a country’s development and progress. I partly agree with this view because the level of development of each country should be taken into consideration.
 For less technologically advanced countries, allocating more funds to science-related subjects can enhance national productivity. Sufficient financial support can help schools equip modern laboratories and conduct regular scientific projects, which can motivate more students to develop an interest in science. As a result, these students can become competent scientists, researchers, and skilled workers in key sectors of the economy, such as agriculture, manufacturing, and healthcare. Therefore, it can allow a nation to progress economically.
 However, in more developed countries, science and technology are already strong, so focusing too much on science education may be unnecessary. These countries often have to deal with other important problems, such as social inequality, mental health and a loss of cultural identity. Therefore, issues in science should be considered alongside subjects such as history, literature and ethics. These subjects can help students think deeply, understand different cultures, and better appreciate their own traditions and customs. In addition, the arts can encourage emotional understanding, which is important for a balanced society. Moreover, other academic areas can support science itself. For example, ethics can guide how new technology should be used in a fair and responsible way, while artistic thinking can inspire innovation in science by offering new ways to look at problems. If these areas are ignored, a country may grow quickly in terms of technology but become weak in culture and human connection.
 In conclusion, I believe that the amount of money spent on science education should depend on each country’s level of development.

reviews.question:
Many people argue that in order to improve educational quality, high school students should be encouraged to make comments or even criticism on their teachers. Others; however, think it will lead to loss of respect and discipline in the classroom.
Discuss both views and give your opinion.
reviews.originalEssay:
Some argue that high school students should be allowed to comment on or even criticize their teachers to improve the quality of education. In contrast, others believe this may undermine respect and discipline in the classroom. In my opinion, I partly agree with this idea, as student feedback can be useful if it is given respectfully and appropriately.
 On the one hand, giving teachers more chances to get to know their students can bring several benefits. Comments from learners can help teachers become better informed about their students’ learning needs, so they can adopt or modify their teaching methods to meet those needs. As a result, this can create a clearer benefit to the progress of every student. Moreover, feedback from students can prevent teachers from becoming complacent, as they know that their teaching will be evaluated regularly. Therefore, it can encourage them to improve their teaching styles and methods continuously, which can contribute to the enhancement of teaching and the learning environment as a whole.
 On the other hand, some students may assess their teachers based on their own feelings and preferences rather than their teachers’ contributions or techniques. For example, a student may evaluate their teacher’s performance as poor simply because they do not like the teacher’s fashion style. Furthermore, in a classroom with massive numbers of comments from learners, opinions may vary greatly from student to student. As a result, it may become impossible for teachers to work out a way of teaching that satisfies all students.
 In conclusion, the stronger argument is in favor of encouraging student comments and criticism because of the pronounced educational advantages it offers, provided that these evaluations are established in a constructive and objective manner to allow for meaningful feedback that benefits both teachers and students alike.
reviews.overall: Em bám rất sát đủ hai phía, các chuỗi ý và ví dụ của đề. Em cần làm rõ đại từ nối ý để mạch phát triển trong thân bài rõ hơn.

reviews.question:
Schools are no longer necessary because children can get so much information available through the Internet, and they can study just as well at home.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, many people believe that schools are no longer necessary because children can easily get a lot of information from the Internet and study effectively at home. However, I completely disagree with this opinion.
 On the one hand, Although the Internet has made educational content more accessible than ever before, enabling children to find video tutorials, e-books and interactive learning tools on virtually any subject, often free of charge, and although this flexibility can serve as a valuable supplement for self-motivated learners, having access to information is by no means the same as knowing how to learn effectively, since young learners often lack the discipline, critical thinking skills and time-management abilities needed to navigate and organise information independently, and without the professional guidance of trained teachers and the structure that schools provide, many students may become overwhelmed or misinformed, resulting in only a superficial or incorrect understanding.
 On the other hand, the role of schools cannot be replaced, because while one of their main purposes is to provide academic instruction, their significance goes far beyond merely teaching facts or theories from textbooks; they also offer a structured learning environment in which students can develop essential life skills such as teamwork, communication, and discipline, and they serve as important social spaces where students compete, cooperate, face challenges, and deal with a wide range of emotions, helping them grow emotionally and socially in ways that cannot be gained by studying alone at home.
 In conclusion, although the Internet provides useful learning resources, schools still play an essential role and cannot be replaced by online study alone.
reviews.overall: Em bám rất sát dàn ý: Body 1 vừa thừa nhận lợi ích của Internet vừa giải thích rõ vì sao trẻ vẫn cần trường học, còn Body 2 phát triển đúng vai trò xã hội của trường. Lập trường không đồng ý nhất quán và các ý được nối theo mạch hợp lí. Em cần soát lại chữ hoa sau dấu phẩy. Hãy tách câu Body 1 quá dài để ý nhượng bộ, phản biện và hệ quả rõ hơn.

reviews.question:
In today’s world of advanced science and technology, people still greatly value artists such as musicians, writers, and painters.
What can the arts tell us about life that science and technology cannot?
reviews.originalEssay:
In the modern world, although science and technology have developed rapidly, people still attach great importance to artists such as musicians, writers, and painters. In my opinion, I believe that art can show us things that science and technology cannot.
 Firstly, the arts excel at conveying human emotions, something science and technology often fail to capture. For example, the responses of the human body and brain to nervousness and excitement are exactly the same, as seen in the way our palms begin to sweat, our hearts start to beat faster, and adrenaline is produced in a certain region of the brain. Even the most advanced medical technologies, such as MRI scanners, could detail how our brain responds to external and internal cues, showing almost identical results for these two feelings. However, science cannot tell what a person is really going through. In contrast, the arts can deliver such unique emotions. For example, a song can express the joy of falling in love or the agony of heartbreak in a way that numbers and graphs cannot. It is therefore not surprising that there are now billions of songs about love, yet each tells a different story and conveys a different shade of feelings. 
 Secondly, art can help us understand human problems that science cannot solve. For instance, questions such as “What is happiness?” still puzzle psychologists, philosophers, and scientists alike. In scientific terms, happiness is explained as the presence of certain conditions: personal achievement, material possessions, or stable relationships. However, real life proves otherwise, as many individuals with fame, wealth, and seemingly perfect families still suffer from deep misery, sometimes even leading to suicide. Therefore, science struggles to explain this paradox, but writers, composers, and painters have long portrayed such inner pain through poems, songs, and paintings. For example, Billie Eilish, one of the most successful singers in the US, vividly conveyed her loneliness beneath glamour and success in When the Party Is Over.
 In conclusion, I believe that the arts can help us understand human emotions and complex aspects of life that science and technology cannot fully explain.
reviews.overall: Em đã trả lời đúng câu hỏi bằng hai đoạn: nghệ thuật truyền tải cảm xúc và giúp người đọc hiểu những trải nghiệm bên trong; ví dụ bài hát và Billie Eilish đều gắn với ý chính. Mở bài còn dùng hai khung nêu quan điểm liên tiếp và trả lời khá chung bằng “things”. Em hãy nêu rõ hai khía cạnh ấy ngay từ mở bài. Ở các ví dụ về MRI và hạnh phúc, em cần diễn đạt có mức độ để không biến dấu hiệu hoặc điều kiện bên ngoài thành kết luận tuyệt đối về cảm xúc.

In the modern world, although science and technology have developed rapidly, people still attach great importance to artists such as musicians, writers, and painters. I believe that the arts reveal personal emotions and aspects of human experience that scientific measurements alone cannot fully convey.
Firstly, the arts excel at conveying human emotions, something science and technology often fail to capture. For example, the bodily signs of nervousness and excitement can look similar: our palms may begin to sweat, our hearts may beat faster, and our bodies release adrenaline. Even advanced medical technologies such as MRI scanners can detail aspects of how the brain responds to external and internal cues, but similar readings alone may not reveal whether a person feels nervous or excited. In contrast, the arts can communicate the distinct ways such emotions are experienced. A song, for example, can express the joy of falling in love or the agony of heartbreak in a way that numbers and graphs cannot. It is therefore not surprising that countless songs about love tell different stories and convey different shades of feeling.
Secondly, art can help us explore abstract questions about human life that scientific measures alone may not settle. For instance, the question ‘What is happiness?’ still puzzles psychologists, philosophers, and scientists alike. Researchers may examine conditions associated with happiness, such as personal achievement, material possessions, and stable relationships. Yet these conditions do not guarantee it: some individuals with fame, wealth, and seemingly perfect families still suffer from deep misery, sometimes even leading to suicide. This contrast shows why outward circumstances alone do not fully convey inner experience. Writers, composers, and painters can portray such pain through poems, songs, and paintings. For example, Billie Eilish, one of the most successful singers in the United States, conveyed loneliness beneath glamour and success in When the Party Is Over. Her song gives listeners a sense of that experience that a list of achievements cannot provide.
In conclusion, the arts can help us understand human emotions and complex aspects of life that scientific measurements cannot fully convey.

reviews.question:
Some people think history has nothing or little to tell us, but others think that studying the past can help us better understand the present.
Discuss both views and give your opinion.
reviews.originalEssay:
Some people believe that history has little value in modern life, while others think that it can help us understand the present better. In my opinion, studying history is still important because it provides useful lessons for our lives today.
 Firstly, learning about historical events may seem to be merely a recording of facts from a bygone era, so these facts may only be relevant to the specific context in which they occurred. Given the rapid advancement of science and technology, today's world has evolved so much that many lessons from the past may appear irrelevant. For example, strategies used in ancient wars are no longer applicable today, as contemporary attacks involve cyber-attacks, artificial intelligence, economic sanctions, and other modern methods rather than traditional battlefields. Therefore, insights gained from history may appear disconnected from present-day realities.
 However, I believe that some seemingly trivial historical facts can provide invaluable lessons for today's world. By studying the root causes of past wars, we can learn how to prevent conflicts and promote peace. In the past, civilizations invaded one another because they believed that they could only prosper at the expense of others. History has shown that such a belief is false, and global cooperation is essential for national growth. Similarly, armed conflicts bring nothing but economic losses, not only from the cost of weapons but also from the decline in economic activity. This explains why wars are rare today, as almost every leader strives for peace and political stability to ensure their nation's prosperity and progress. Therefore, such insights are a valuable fruit of studying the past.
 In conclusion, history is still important because it helps us learn from the past and avoid making the same mistakes again.
reviews.overall: Cô thấy em đã bàn cả hai quan điểm, giữ rõ lập trường ủng hộ việc học lịch sử và triển khai gần đủ các bước trong dàn ý. Body 1 đi thẳng từ “Firstly” vào một lý do, nên em cần thêm câu chủ đề bao quát và nói rõ đây là cách nhìn của những người xem lịch sử ít hữu ích. Ở Body 2, “Similarly” chưa đúng khi em chuyển từ lợi ích của hợp tác sang tổn thất do xung đột; em dùng “By contrast” để thể hiện quan hệ đối lập. Em giữ các bước giải thích và ví dụ còn lại.

reviews.question:
Most people have forgotten the meaning behind traditional or religious festivals; during festival periods, people nowadays only want to enjoy themselves.
To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?
reviews.originalEssay:
Many people today have forgotten the real meaning of traditional and religious festivals. They only want to enjoy themselves during these times. I agree with this opinion because many people no longer understand the real meaning of festivals and only want to have fun.  
 Many people today have forgotten the real meaning of traditional and religious festivals. They only want to enjoy themselves during these times. I agree with this opinion because many people no longer understand the real meaning of festivals and only want to have fun. The underlying meaning of festivals in many places has largely been forgotten. For example, Vietnamese people interpret the meaning of activities during Tet very differently from previous generations. Younger generations often think that giving money to children during this holiday is simply a token of good luck. However, this interpretation is far from the truth. Traditionally, giving money to children was meant to protect them from lost souls, as the money acted as a bribe so that malevolent spirits would not harm the children.
 Religious and traditional festivals have become times for celebration rather than serious cultural practice. In Vietnam, for instance, Tet used to be a festival period when people spent time shopping, decorating their homes, and enjoying traditional meals with their families. In contrast, most young Vietnamese people now look forward to Tet as an occasion to have fun or a long holiday period, rather than a time to engage in traditional activities. Many of them consider going to temples to pray for good fortune and asking for old-school calligraphy a fun activity rather than a religious one. Many others decide to go on a trip instead of enjoying their families’ company.
 In conclusion, I agree that people have forgotten the meaning of traditional and religious festivals. Nowadays, they only use these times to have fun.

Tuy nhiên, em chép lại nguyên mở bài ở đầu Body 1, khiến câu chủ đề bị đẩy xuống sau phần lặp. Mở bài cũng mới đổi ít từ của đề; câu nêu quan điểm lặp lại hai vế. appliedKnowledge.originalEvidence: Many people today have forgotten the real meaning of traditional and religious festivals.
appliedKnowledge.revisionEvidence: Traditional and religious festivals seem to be losing some of their original significance as personal enjoyment becomes a stronger focus.
appliedKnowledge.explanation: Cô gợi ý em diễn đạt lại mối quan hệ giữa ý nghĩa cũ và việc ưu tiên vui chơi bằng cấu trúc mới, thay vì chỉ đổi vài từ của đề.

appliedKnowledge.originalEvidence: I agree with this opinion because many people no longer understand the real meaning of festivals and only want to have fun.
appliedKnowledge.revisionEvidence: I strongly believe that many people are less aware of what these celebrations mean and increasingly treat them as opportunities for pleasure.
